text: 重庆都市圈建设“十五五”规划出炉，目标GDP超3.6万亿 成都都市圈和重庆都市圈未来5年GDP将超过7.5万亿元。
text_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan for Chongqing metropolitan area development is released, with a target GDP of over 3.6 trillion yuan; the Chengdu metropolitan area and Chongqing metropolitan area will exceed 7.5 trillion yuan in GDP over the next five years.
